options.title: Write a test for the last thing you built
options.body: Pick the single most critical behaviour you implemented in the last few prompts and write one test for it — the happy path only. A test written now, while the logic is fresh, is worth five written at the end of the session once context has drifted.

options.title: Write one test now
options.body: Write one test for the riskiest thing you just built — happy path is enough. Do it now while it's fresh.

options.title: One test, right now
options.body: Write one test for what you just built. Just the happy path.
